title: approval.denied
description: A human rejected a gated action. Emitted by core/approvals.py::resolve(). Consumed by the ops notifier (Slack integration exists as of M1.3, but interactions/slack.py updates the original Slack message directly and synchronously as part of resolving the decision — no separate notifier job is wired for this event in M1.3).

reason.description: The decider's stated reason, when given. Null is honest for a plain Reject click with no reason text captured — never invented.
